metadata.database: A Deeper China | Guilin–Yangshuo point decision layer

GY001.guest_value: Separate water, land, photography, movement and rest priorities before choosing transport.
GY001.choose_rule: Use before naming a cruise, raft or hike.
GY001.stop_after: One landscape question and one acceptable physical mode are clear.

GY002.guest_value: Offer one iconic karst relationship without collecting viewpoints.
GY002.choose_rule: Use when the guest accepts crowds/transfer for a recognisable landscape frame.

GY003.guest_value: Make a long river day an explicit water, motion and transfer decision.
GY003.choose_rule: Choose only after operator, water, weather, luggage and return checks.
GY003.stop_after: The chosen river relationship and return plan are complete.

GY004.guest_value: Offer river landscape without a long cruise or motion commitment.
GY004.choose_rule: Use when land-based views fit the body and weather better.

GY005.guest_value: Use the Yulong area for a countryside rhythm rather than a forced sport.
GY005.choose_rule: Choose by bike/raft/walk/vehicle tolerance and current conditions.
GY005.stop_after: One safe countryside movement pattern is complete.

GY006.guest_value: Keep Yangshuo meaningful without assuming cycling or rafting.
GY006.choose_rule: Use confirmed public walk/vehicle-assisted options only.
GY006.stop_after: The countryside question is answered without an unwanted activity.

GY007.guest_value: Offer a bamboo-raft decision only when water, operator and motion tolerance fit.
GY007.choose_rule: Never imply a scenic/quiet guarantee or add to a long cruise by default.
GY007.stop_after: One water movement experience is enough.

GY008.guest_value: Make West Street a mood/energy choice rather than an authenticity claim.
GY008.choose_rule: Choose only if nightlife, retail or convenience is desired.
GY008.stop_after: The visitor has a comfortable town exit and does not need to browse every shop.

GY009.guest_value: Place nights and energy where the countryside plan can actually work.
GY009.choose_rule: Choose by noise, transport, luggage and recovery needs.
GY009.stop_after: The base supports the selected landscape mode without nightly relocation.

GY010.guest_value: Offer one bounded karst walk with honest steps and exposure.
GY010.choose_rule: Use only after footing, heat and return checks.
GY010.stop_after: The viewpoint question is answered before fatigue/risk rises.

GY011.guest_value: Make visibility, light and safety part of the image decision.
GY011.choose_rule: Use as a method, not a promised photo position or weather condition.
GY011.stop_after: One visual question is answered without unsafe positioning.

GY012.guest_value: Clarify when adventure activity is outside this roadbook until safety/operation evidence exists.
GY012.choose_rule: Do not sell climbing, rafting or extreme activity from a lead or social post.
GY012.stop_after: The guest accepts a public low-risk alternative or the activity is declined.

GY013.guest_value: Protect arrival day from luggage, water and weather pressure.
GY013.choose_rule: Build from arrival time, hotel and next transfer.
GY013.stop_after: The visitor is rested and oriented for the landscape day.

GY014.guest_value: Offer a real Guilin city layer when transfer or weather makes Yangshuo unwise.
GY014.choose_rule: Use one confirmed cultural/nature layer near the base.
GY014.stop_after: The city chapter supports recovery rather than becoming another checklist.

GY015.guest_value: Make Longji a separate mountain/terrace day decision.
GY015.choose_rule: Do not squeeze it into a three-night Yangshuo plan.
GY015.stop_after: The visitor accepts transfer, visibility and terrain cost.

GY016.guest_value: Give three nights a coherent Guilin–Yangshuo core with buffers.
GY016.choose_rule: Choose water, countryside and recovery anchors; no Longji by default.
GY016.stop_after: The guest has a workable sequence and one weather fallback.

GY017.guest_value: Use five nights for one deeper mountain or water question, not more rushed scenery.
GY017.choose_rule: Add Longji or a second layer only when it earns the extra day.
GY017.stop_after: Each extra day answers a different landscape question.

GY018.guest_value: Pass a Guangzhou connection to a separate approved city database.
GY018.choose_rule: Use only after transfer time and minimum stay are explicit.
GY018.stop_after: The transfer decision is made; no bundled itinerary is implied.

GY019.guest_value: Pass a Zhangjiajie decision to a separate approved database.
GY019.choose_rule: Use only for a real additional mountain/landscape block.
GY019.stop_after: The visitor accepts the transfer and extra nights.

GY020.guest_value: Teach countryside observation without turning residents or agriculture into scenery.
GY020.choose_rule: Stay on public routes; no private homes, staged contact or assumed portraits.
GY020.stop_after: One public landscape/life pattern is understood without intrusion.
